detail.longDescription: Open Academy is an open-source app inspired by Math Academy ( https://mathacademy.com/ ). You use it to create courses on any subject, taught in a similar way. If you're unfamiliar with Math Academy, it's a maths learning site with short lessons, lots of practice questions, and reviews that bring old topics back before you forget them. I really enjoyed using it to study maths, but I couldn't find anything similar for other subjects. At the same time, I was using AI a lot to learn new topics but my lessons had no structure. So I built Open Academy to bridge that gap. You create courses with your AI of choice through the CLI, ideally grounded in your own notes or content from the web. The app handles the rest, which includes prerequisite locks, quizzes and spaced review (FSRS). I don't intend to make a managed version of this. The repo and the demo include example courses: Maths for ML, ML Foundations, Deep Learning, Transformers and LLMs, LLM Inference and Reinforcement Learning so you can get a feel fo rit. MIT licensed. Runs with Docker, on Vercel with Neon, or fork it do with it as you please as far as hosting is concerned. Demo: https://open-academy-demo.vercel.app
